'''Mohammad Saleh Zarepour''' is an [[Iranian peoples|Iranian]] [[philosopher]] and senior lecturer at the Department of Philosophy of the [[University of Manchester]]. He is a winner of [[Philip Leverhulme Prize]] (2023) and a Life Member of [[Clare Hall College]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Philosophy: Dr Mohammad Saleh Zarepour awarded Philip Leverhulme Prize 2023 |url=https://www.clarehall.cam.ac.uk/news/philosophy-dr-mohammad-saleh-zarepour-awarded-philip-leverhulme-prize/ |website=[[Clare Hall, Cambridge]] |date=15 March 2024}}</ref> Zarepour is known for his works on [[medieval Islamic philosophy]], [[philosophy of religion]], [[philosophy of language]], [[philosophy of mathematics]], and [[philosophy of logic]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Mohammed Saleh Zarepour |url=https://closertotruth.com/contributor/mohammed-saleh-zarepour/ |website=[[Closer To Truth]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Gutas |first1=Dimitri |title=The Myth of a Kantian Avicenna |journal=Philosophy East and West |date=2020 |volume=70 |issue=3 |pages=833–840 |doi=10.1353/pew.2020.0039 |jstor=27050930 |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/27050930 |issn=0031-8221}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Booth |first1=Anthony Robert |last2=Kaukua |first2=Jari |last3=Stephenson |first3=Andrew |title=Mind and knowledge of mind in classical Islamic philosophy |journal=British Journal for the History of Philosophy |date=3 July 2024 |volume=32 |issue=4 |pages=699–703 |doi=10.1080/09608788.2024.2378820 |issn=0960-8788|doi-access=free }}</ref>

==Books==
* ''Medieval Finitism'', Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2025
* ''Necessary Existence and Monotheism: An Avicennian Account of the Islamic Conception of Divine Unity'', Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2022<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Alsamaani |first1=Nader |title=Mohammad Saleh Zarepour Necessary Existence and Monotheism (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2022). Pp. 1 + 75. £15.00 (Pbk). ISBN 9781108940054. |journal=Religious Studies |date=September 2023 |volume=59 |issue=3 |pages=566–569 |doi=10.1017/S0034412522000555 |language=en |issn=0034-4125}}</ref>

===edited===
* ''Logic, Soul, and World: Essays in Arabic Philosophy in Honor of Tony Street'', edited with Asad Q. Ahmed and Riccardo Strobino, Leiden: Brill, 2025
* ''Global Dialogues in the Philosophy of Religion From Religious Experience to the Afterlife'', edited with [[Yujin Nagasawa]], New York: Oxford University Press, 2024
* ''Islamic Philosophy of Religion'', New York: Routledge, 2024<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Turner |first1=Jamie |title=Zarepour, Mohammad Saleh. (Ed.) Islamic Philosophy of Religion: Essays from Analytic Perspectives. Abingdon: Routledge, 299 pp. |journal=AGATHEOS: European Journal for Philosophy of Religion |date=28 November 2025 |volume=2 |issue=3 |pages=86–89 |doi=10.69574/aejpr.v2i3.60537|doi-access=free }}</ref>
* ''Mathematics, Logic, and their Philosophies'', edited with Mojtaba Mojtahedi and Shahid Rahman, Dordrecht: Springer, 2021
